name: Whoosh + swipe
how: Place tr-swipe so its middle is on the cut; sfx-place whoosh at the start of the swipe.

name: Hit + flash
how: tr-flash centred on the beat; sfx-place hit on the cut frame.
about: The classic impact. The flash peaks on the hit.

name: Riser into zoom-through
how: sfx-place riser to end on the reveal; hook-zoom-through starts 0.1 s before it ends.

name: Thud + slam text
how: hook-slam with a thud on each word (one per word, cap 4).
about: Each word lands with a low hit.

name: Clicks + typewriter
how: typewriter-disclaimer with a click every 2 to 3 letters.

name: Pops on caption pops
how: stylebrain sfx-auto caps pops to a few per minute; add only on key words.
about: Soft pops on the most important words, not every word.

name: Silence before the drop
how: Cut the music for 0.3 to 0.5 s before the payoff, then bring it back on the hit.
about: The gap makes the hit feel bigger.

name: Record scratch + freeze
how: Freeze frame plus a text_fx label ("yep, that's me"); a scratch sound on the freeze.

name: Glitch sound + glitch wipe
how: tr-glitch on the cut with a glitch sound at its start.

name: Plate drop on the lockout
how: sfx-place thud (or his recorded plate drop) on the lockout frame; hold 0.3 s.
about: Real gym sound as the payoff beat.
